what: The red, green and blue of the photo (a three plane) are sampled at different strengths (.1 · .5 · 1 — for photos on screen .1 · .2 · .3) from random spots along the diagonal and scattered like TV noise, then the strength is reduced 1 → 0 (applied as a square so the end is soft) and the photo gathers into its true form. The Hero waits .5s after the image loads and then runs 2s circ.out, while photos entering by scroll run 1.5s from top 85% (touch 1s). Drawing stops once everything has gathered.

options.on: ”load” (default) starts delay after the image arrives, ”scroll” when it reaches start
options.delay: Pause before start (sec), default load .5 · scroll 0
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name · four numbers), default circ.out
options.spread: Three red, green, blue scatter intensity values, default ”0.1 0.5 1” — for photo cells ”0.1 0.2 0.3”
options.rate: Speed at which noise scrolls (per second), default 1 — photo slot original is .5
options.start: on: scroll start line, default top 85%
options.fit: “stretch” stretches to fill the panel. Default is cover (crops the overflowing side from the center)
options.narrow: At this width (px) or below, switch to the image-narrow picture, default 835
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Photos to scatter — Already drawn by me

note: On start the board fires fx:ready (the original lifts the loader and starts the headline and typing at that moment). Once the painting board is up, the original photo is visibility: hidden, so without WebGL the photo stays visible. The original subpage photo slot (.js-glelements) takes the form on: scroll · spread: 0.1 0.2 0.3 · rate: 0.5 (no recorded page uses it, so it is not applied in the copy).

from.where: index.html .al-mv — full-bleed Hero photo (load .5s later, 2s circ.out, intensity .1 · .5 · 1)
